note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. Two of the nine seats were contested and both were retained by the retiring Unionist members (Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1955, p. 7). The seven uncontested divisions are from the returning officer's notice of result (Belfast Telegraph, 7 June 1955, p. 10): six members returned unopposed and, with no nomination for Ballyhackamore, its retiring member William John Pettigrew deemed re-elected (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
